entries.title: Day one: born goofy
entries.look: A smooth pink brain with googly eyes, buck teeth, blushing cheeks and one sprout on top. Eyes follow your finger. Mouth opens when you tap it.
entries.brain: 384 neurons, about 483,000 connections, all random noise at birth. Two hidden layers. Reads 32 characters at a time and guesses the next one.
features: 171 clean jokes and 30 knock-knocks, both directions
Math that shows its work, plus a leveling kids quiz
Memory lobe: approved meals answer instantly, credited to the feeder
Under the hood: explains its own code with pictures
Five-layer safety lobe and a rewind button
Grows new neurons when it earns a stage (function-preserving widening)

entries.title: Day three: spinach, chlorella and a library card
entries.look: Little muscles, two more sprouts, and a stretch when it grows. New things to say when you tap it.
entries.brain: 584 neurons (was 480), growing 8 per meal from a person, ceiling 4,096. A Library lobe of openly licensed knowledge, credited by source. Nightly backups and a failure alarm.
features: Grows neurons the moment a meal is approved
Library lobe: Simple Wikipedia summaries and filtered human Q&A (CC BY-SA)
Knowledge drops up to 4,000 characters, 10 a day
No feeder over a quarter of a night's study
Nightly backups and a failure alarm

upcoming.tease: Neurons start to glow and fire across the surface.
Visible pathways light up when it answers. Rock knowledge: probable.
Little muscles. Don't ask. It's been working out.
A glasses upgrade and the first bigger brain.
